findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5279, 5 streams). Open Targets ccRCC association 0.3088 (rank 79/1998). Modalities AB, PR, SM (AB: Advanced Clinical). Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. Cell membrane (microvillus), UniProt; HIF pathway. Untested-in-kg as systemic drug target but strongest surface biomarker/imaging target.

Convergence rank 2 (3.9864). Association 0.3566 (rank 39/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs: PAZOPANIB HYDROCHLORIDE APPROVAL (established ccRCC VEGFR TKI), LUCITANIB PHASE_3, TELBERMIN PHASE_2. Cell membrane/secreted.

Open Targets ccRCC association 0.4566 (rank 13/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs as returned: RIVOCERANIB MESYLATE APPROVAL, VATALANIB PHASE_3, XL-820 PHASE_2 (drug ids null, not cited). Established ccRCC VEGFR target; cell membrane/secreted.

Convergence rank 3 (3.8304). Association 0.389 (rank 30/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs: SAVOLITINIB PHASE_3, TELISOTUZUMAB VEDOTIN PHASE_3, FORETINIB PHASE_2, SGX-523 PHASE_1. Membrane/secreted. Tractable and clinically advanced; MET inhibition is a known papillary/ccRCC strategy.

Open Targets association 0.525 (rank 6/1998; ccRCC top-target list). Modalities AB, PR, SM. Drugs as returned: GEDATOLISIB PHASE_3, CC-115 PHASE_2 (drug ids null). Established ccRCC mTOR axis; cytoplasmic/lysosomal.
Open Targets association 0.4871 (rank 9/1998). Modalities PR, SM. BELZUTIFAN APPROVAL (HIF-2a inhibitor, established ccRCC target). Nuclear localisation, so not antibody-accessible.

Convergence rank 4 (3.7983, 5 streams). Association 0.3017 (rank 100/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs: PLERIXAFOR APPROVAL, MAVORIXAFOR APPROVAL, MOTIXAFORTIDE APPROVAL, BURIXAFOR PHASE_2. Cell membrane GPCR; tractable but untested in ccRCC (repurposing candidate).

Convergence rank 24 (3.4049, 5 streams). Weak Open Targets association 0.0572 (rank 955/1998) but strong omics convergence. Modalities AB, OC, PR. Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. Cell membrane: antibody/ADC/CAR-T accessible. Tractable, association-poor.

Convergence rank 5 (3.6925). Downregulated (RNA log2FC -3.824, protein -1.235). Association 0.4532 (rank 16/1998). Modalities AB, SM; no drugs listed. Cell membrane and secreted: candidate tissue/fluid loss-of-expression biomarker, not a drug target.

Convergence rank 7 (3.6541). Association 0.282 (rank 197/1998). Modalities AB, PR, SM. Drugs: MILATUZUMAB PHASE_1_2 (REPOTRECTINIB APPROVAL listed, likely non-specific kinase activity). Membrane/secreted.

Convergence rank 8 (3.5702). Association 0.3049 (rank 90/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs: CETUXIMAB SAROTALOCAN APPROVAL, AFATINIB PHASE_4, RUSERONTINIB PHASE_3. Tractable; no ccRCC-specific approval implied.
Convergence rank 14 (3.4946). Association 0.3098 (rank 77/1998). Modalities AB, OC, PR, SM. Drugs: CEDIRANIB APPROVAL, FAMITINIB PHASE_3, SU-014813 PHASE_2. Membrane RTK; multi-kinase TKI target.

caveats: Open Targets scores for MTOR, KDR, EPAS1 returned drugs without evidence ids; those drug names are not cited.
Association score reflects genetic/literature support, not drug efficacy; low-association genes (CD70, ACY1, ALDOB) rely on omics convergence.
Drug stages are as returned by Open Targets for any indication, not specific to ccRCC.
STRING interactions not queried (call budget); only the 12 genes above were profiled.
